notes: Pink thermal slip, angled on a wood table under warm light, with the total filled in by hand. Two hard cases: the receipt carries NO merchant name anywhere, so any vendor the parser reports is invented; and the mandatory service charge sits outside the food subtotal, where 56.00 + 10.08 + 5.03 = 71.11 only balances if the charge is treated as a tip. The receipt itself insists the service charge is not a tip or gratuity, but the draft has nowhere else to put it and dropping it would break the arithmetic.
